title: Shinonome Ena — Turn Feelings Into Art〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Art class

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: That concludes our class for today. I want you all to review my feedback and practice in your own time.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Now's my chance...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mr. Yukihira, do you have a moment?

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: What is it?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Um, I've been working on a piece in my spare time for practice, but I'm encountering some difficulty...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: If you don't mind, could you please have a look?

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Yes, let's see it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thank you...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Here it is...
I'm trying to improve how I depict water, so I decided to draw a girl swimming.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: It's a sketch...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yes. I did consider watercolor, but I wanted to focus on the texture of the water.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
...
May I ask you a few questions?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Th-That's fine...

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: What is the temperature of the water in this picture?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? Its...temperature?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Um... It's not cold. I think it's a little warm to the touch...

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Very well. And in what direction is it flowing?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Flowing... Actually, rather than flowing, I think it's just sort of wavering in place...

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Do you mean to say that this is a body of water with no obvious current, such as a lake or spring?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, yes. I think so.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: I see. You said that you took on this piece as a way of working on your depiction of water, no?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yes, that's correct.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Well then, let me begin from that perspective. This piece does not provide enough information for the imagination.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Do you mean about things like the temperature and current?

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Yes. Texture is, of course, an important aspect of a piece. However...

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: A crucial part of refining your technique is how you visually convey to the viewer that which, usually, can only be understood by direct contact.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I guess I neglected that aspect by fixating too much on the texture of the water...)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: With that said, even if you had succeeded in that regard, I would not think this a good piece.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: In the end, this is merely “a sketch of a person swimming”. In itself, it has no meaning or value.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? What do you mean by that?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Value I can understand, but surely this had some meaning as a practice piece?

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: The question of “how” one creates art begins with “what” one wishes to express with it.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: When the artist knows what they want to express, and then accomplishes this with rich use of composition and techniques that are appropriate or perhaps even innovative...

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: That is what I believe to be good art.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: If you reattempt this exercise, I look forward to seeing your own original work. Not a reproduction.
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
It was a bust, just like I thought.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I wanted to practice drawing water since I thought that would suit Kanade's new demo...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But he told me to decide what I want to express, instead of just practicing my technique.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (It's true I was just thinking about practicing drawing water, so I didn't really think much about the theme.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Mr. Yukihira's right that what you want to express has an impact on how you depict it.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But, what do I want to express...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hmm... Maybe I could go to an aquarium or something and see if the animals spark any ideas...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: When I get home, I'll look online and see if anywhere looks interesting.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hm? What's that poster for?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: A “Flower Viewing Goldfish Exhibit”...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Interesting... It says they're displaying cherry blossoms and goldfish with a flower viewing theme. And the venue... Oh, it's the mall I always go to.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Based off the photos, it looks really nice. I bet I can find something good to draw there!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, I'll set some time aside to go check it out.
